prompt_en: A wide cinematic adventure photograph of the same clearly adult woman suggested by the supplied portrait, recognizable from behind by her long silver-ash twin ponytails, now dressed as a seasoned treasure hunter in a weathered leather field jacket, utility belt, sturdy trousers, boots, and a compact explorer's pack. She stands at the edge of a high rugged cliff, viewed fully from behind, quietly surveying a vast valley at sunrise. Her compact full-length silhouette occupies the lower center beneath a sweeping expanse of valley and sky. The rising sun breaks over distant mountains, revealing a winding river, forests, and half-buried ancient ruins through thin mist. Cool blue shadow pools across the foreground rocks while the horizon glows amber. Her shoulders are relaxed, chin slightly lifted, and stance calm and grounded, expressing satisfied pride after a difficult journey. Wind lifts her ponytails and jacket hem. Realistic natural light, tactile worn gear, atmospheric depth, crisp photographic detail.
negative_en: fake-looking background, unrealistic hands, body distortion, plastic-looking skin, over-processed retouching, cartoon style, 3D render look
